scalars.scalar_value: Advanced experience preparing and editing manuscripts for publication.

items.item_text: Advanced experience preparing and editing manuscripts for publication.
Experience supporting grant preparation, submission, or research project coordination.
Coordinate day-to-day operations in support of the PI, including managing schedules, meetings, and communications with research staff and collaborators.
Review and edit scientific documents such as manuscripts, protocols, and reports, and provide concise summaries to support PI review.
Assist with preparation and organization of research materials, presentations, and documentation.
Support coordination of research projects by tracking action items, deadlines, and deliverables across team members.
Facilitate communication within the laboratory to ensure alignment on priorities and timelines.
Provide administrative oversight and guidance for general lab operations and processes.
Familiarity with scientific publishing processes and/or reference management tools (e.g., EndNote, Zotero, Mendeley).
Interpersonal and communication skills to communicate and interact in a helpful, effective, and informative manner with a wide variety of individuals.
